about: The limits of the picture comparison (docs/openfallout/picture-comparison.md, 'The limit'). method: how the pictures are measured. allowance: what two renderers may legitimately differ by, the limits of a scene until its own are set from runs. margin: how far above its noise floor a scene's limit sits (worst value x factor + pad; for ssim and worst_tile_ssim the same on the distance from 1). scenes: the limits set from the first runs, written by `picturecompare.py limits --write`. noise_floor: what those runs measured.
